race.comment: STARTIN'SUMTHIN' (6) gets the nod with race fitness on her side and a 1.5kg claim helping offset a plain Ballarat sixth over 2648m, where she was beaten just over seven lengths at big odds. She has to turn that into a sharper 2000m performance, but this field gives her that opening. CREUSA (3) is the most reliable recent runner, having placed at Avoca before finishing second at this track last start, and her record around 2000m reads three starts for two placings. JUST BASIL (2) brings first-time blinkers and Jake Duffy, the top-ranked jockey for wins at this track, though slow getaways have been costly. SPIN CLASS (5) was better when fifth at Avoca, but CREUSA had her measure there. Can contest for a place.
